name: Cometary-Cwm
description: The sea here is thick with dissolved metals, so sunsets burn green and gold above the waves. Beneath them wait a tidally locked hemisphere, and everything the light never reaches.

Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound. Fossil beds suggest rich seas once flourished here; now the chemistry records only a slow suffocation.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on medicinal compounds are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
